title: Persisted bilingual editorial revisions, guarded publication and rollback
summary: Local six-migration workflow with immutable revisions, exact-version review, owner-only publication, rollback snapshots and a bilingual editor. Hosted operations remain blocked.

changes.detail: Separate append-only bilingual draft revisions and decisions, source/version fencing, approval invalidation, guarded publication and snapshot rollback. New API enforces owner publication and explicit confirmation.
Bilingual editing, evidence fields, explicit AI import, conflict comparison/manual rebase, paginated revision history and French public description reader.
Legacy metadata approval/reset clears editorial publication to prevent mismatched public descriptions. AI completion never writes editorial revisions.

validation.name: Local SQL/API/UI/static regression
validation.detail: Pending. No hosted database write, deployment, paid AI or worker activation.
